titles.title: Red Hills with Pedernal, White Clouds

description: Red hills slope diagonally across the composition's foreground. Green trees stand on the flat land stretching behind the hills. Towering over the scene is Pedernal, painted in shades of blue and green. Above the landscape, the sky glows white where it meets the earth, then deepens to a rich blue at the top edge of the composition.
